sentences.text:
THIS WRIT PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 - 11 -  NC: 2023:KHC:20442  WP No. 24243 of 2021  ORDER

The petitioners who are residents of Dakshina Kannada District, Goa and Maharashtra have called in question the correctness of the award passed under Section 3-G of the National Highways Act,
1956 ("the Act", for short) and Section 29 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 dated 10.12.2020 and have also sought for direction in the nature of writ of mandamus to the first respondent to decide strictly in accordance with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
2.

4. This court in the order passed in W.P.No.13658/2021 relating to land owners who are similarly situated as that of the petitioners had disposed off the petition in terms of the directions extracted below:

6. The learned counsel for the respondent authorities submit that the matter may be disposed off in terms of the directions of the Coordinate Bench passed in identical factual matrix including in W.P.No.13658/2021 dated 13.02.2023.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The petition is disposed off on same terms in W.P.No.13658/2021 dated 13.02.2023.
ii) The dispute involved in the petition with regard to quantum of compensation,
legality, validity and correctness of the award are referred to the Deputy Commissioner/Statutory Authority.
iii) The Deputy Commissioner/Statutory Authority is directed to decide the present grievance raised in the writ petition and dispose off the same in accordance with law.
iv) Liberty is reserved in favour of the petitioners to file pleadings and documents before the Deputy Commissioner/ Statutory Authority pursuant to this award.
v) All rival contentions are kept open and no opinion is expressed on the same.

- 16 - NC: 2023:KHC:20442 vi) The Deputy Commissioner/Statutory Authority is directed to dispose off the proceedings expeditiously.
vii) It is made clear that the order is restricted to the petitioners grievance only and is made in the peculiar/special facts and circumstances of the instant case and shall not be treated as a precedent and is passed taking note of the directions on similarly situated land losers in W.P.No.13658/2021.
viii) Petitioners to file a petition containing the grounds as made out in the present petition along with the copy of the present writ petition within three weeks from today before the Deputy Commissioner/Statutory Authority.

The petitioners who are residents of Dakshina Kannada District, Goa and Maharashtra have called in question the correctness of the award passed under Section 3-G of the National Highways Act,
1956 ("the Act", for short) and Section 29 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 dated 10.12.2020 and have also sought for direction in the nature of writ of mandamus to the first respondent to decide strictly in accordance with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,

4. This court in the order passed in W.P.No.13658/2021 relating to land owners who are similarly situated as that of the petitioners had disposed off the petition in terms of the directions extracted below:

viii) Petitioners to file a petition containing the grounds as made out in the present petition along with the copy of the present writ petition within three weeks from today before the Deputy Commissioner/Statutory Authority.
